identification: Small round (about 2-3cm) 9ct rose gold rimmed badge/brooch with gilt centre, raised 'PPP' and engraved 1898 and 1928 (30-year jubilee, society or lodge unknown). Reverse stamped 9CT and maker F.A.F., pin and safety loop. Title weight '206GM' is an error; the badge is likely a few grams (2.06g or perhaps up to about 6g) and the centre looks gilt base metal with verdigris, so gold content is small. Melt is only a few dollars to maybe $15 to $25. Value is Tasmaniana/lodge collectable interest.

viewing_check: Weigh it if possible, or ask for the weight (title says 206GM, surely 2.06g or similar). Check the PPP meaning and whether the gilt centre is base metal. Check the F.A.F. and 9CT stamps are on the gold rim and for any inscription on the back. Condition of the pin.
